# 🛒 ModernAuction — The Ultimate Asynchronous Auction House

**ModernAuction takes your server's economy to the next level with a zero-lag, asynchronous SQLite backend and competition-ready features for Paper/Spigot 1.20+.
Give your players the ability to participate in bidding wars, instantly purchase items via Buy-It-Now, and filter through massive markets using built-in categories. With advanced Anti-Snipe mechanics, offline-player support, and a highly polished UI, this is the only auction plugin your server will ever need.**

**Engineered for maximum performance and a premium player experience.**

## ✨ Premium GUI Experience

**Immersive and beautiful glass-pane bordered auction menus
Dynamic auditory feedback for bids, purchases, and errors
Seamless pagination to browse thousands of items effortlessly**

## 💰 Advanced Economy & Trading

**List items using /ah sell <startingBid> [binPrice]
Optional Buy-It-Now (BIN) allows buyers to skip the bidding and purchase instantly
Configurable listing taxes and maximum pricing limits to balance your economy
Global limits on how many active auctions a single player can run**

## ⚖️ Anti-Snipe & Fair Play

**Automatically extends the auction timer by 15 seconds if a late bid is placed
Ensures fair bidding wars and prevents last-second auction sniping
Fully compatible with offline players — winnings and items are saved securely**

## 🔍 Smart Filtering & Categories

**Automatic categorization sorts items into Armor, Tools, Blocks, and Items
Dedicated Category Filter button to instantly narrow down the market
Sign-based search input to find exactly what you're looking for
Sort by Newest, Oldest, Cheapest, or Priciest**

## 📦 Player Portfolio (My Items)

**Dedicated GUI to manage all personal auction activity
View Active listings, Expired items, and Sold history in one place
Reclaim expired items or cancel active listings with a single click**

## 🧱 Shulker Box Previews

**Right-click any listed shulker box to safely preview its contents
Read-only preview GUI prevents any item duplication or theft
Bedrock-friendly click support via Geyser/Floodgate**

## 🔔 Asynchronous & Zero-Lag

**All database operations run asynchronously to prevent TPS drops
ActionBar broadcasts when high-value items are listed
Automatic background cleanup of expired listings
PlaceholderAPI support to display live auction stats on your scoreboard**

## 🎨 Highly Configurable

**Customize all messages, UI titles, button lore, and chat formats
Adjust Anti-Snipe timings, listing fees, and expiration durations
Full Minimessage formatting support for beautiful gradients and colors**

## 🔌 Dependencies

**Requires Vault and an economy plugin (like EssentialsX) to handle transactions
Gracefully handles missing economy providers with clear player feedback
Optional PlaceholderAPI hook for %aiolsah_active_listings% and more**

## 🧾 Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| /ah | Open the main Auction House menu |
| /auction | Alias for the /ah command |
| /ah sell <startingBid> [binPrice] | List the item in your main hand |
| /ah search <item> | Open the auction house with a search filter |
| /ah reload | Reload the plugin configuration (Admin only) |

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description |
| --- | --- |
| aiols.ah.use | Allows the player to open and browse the auction house |
| aiols.ah.sell | Allows the player to create new listings |
| aiols.ah.admin | Grants access to the /ah reload command |
| aiols.* | Grants all auction-related permissions |
